note: Members are register-relative variable slugs, and the loader prefixes the group's own register, so the only way a member can name another register is a path-shaped slug ('other/b'). That makes 'scb/test/other/b', which the variable FQID grammar refuses; the writer model's separate 'member belongs to another register' check cannot be reached from a register file. Allowed twin: group-member-shapes-load.
fails_if: the register loader stops checking each [[group]] member against the variable FQID grammar, so a path-shaped member that reaches outside the group's register loads and the build later fails unlocated
